scope: Account entry, authentication, member profile, security, training data and privacy controls in Account.jsx

statusLegend.NOT TESTED: No interaction evidence has been recorded.
statusLegend.PARTIAL: A focused browser test covered only the evidence named here.
statusLegend.PASS: The complete control path, including success and failure handling, was verified against its required backend state.
statusLegend.IN PROGRESS: The current frozen-source test run has started but has no final result yet.
statusLegend.INTERRUPTED: A test run stopped before completion; it is neither a pass nor a failure result.

controls.label: Account
controls.expected: Opens the Account route on desktop and mobile navigation.
controls.evidence: The Account route is reachable through workspace navigation on desktop and mobile; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45 across all five projects. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: New to FORMA? Create account
controls.expected: Shows registration fields and password guidance.
controls.evidence: The real signup journeys reach registration from the Account entry in tests/accounts-security.spec.js, tests/accounts-workouts.spec.js and tests/accounts-lifecycle.spec.js; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45.

controls.label: Display name
controls.expected: Requires a non-empty member display name and limits it to 50 characters.
controls.evidence: Real signup journeys fill a display name and submit successfully in the account security/workout/lifecycle specs. Whitespace and max-length failures are NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Email address
controls.expected: Uses native email validation and submits the address with registration.
controls.evidence: Real signup journeys fill and submit a unique email in account security/workout/lifecycle specs. Invalid-email failure handling is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Password
controls.expected: Requires at least 15 characters and allows long passphrases.
controls.evidence: The guest UI test checks short-password native invalidity; real flows also create accounts with a long passphrase. Upper-bound failure is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Create account
controls.expected: Calls signUp and gives non-enumerating verification guidance.
controls.evidence: Real account suites submit signup, receive the verification message, fetch the verify-email sink URL and follow it. Failure/duplicate-email copy is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Already have an account? Sign in
controls.expected: Returns to sign-in mode.
controls.evidence: The guest flow switches back to the sign-in form and confirms its heading. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Email address
controls.expected: Accepts the member email for authentication.
controls.evidence: Real account suites submit the account email and sign in successfully; invalid email failure is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Password
controls.expected: Accepts current password with password-manager support.
controls.evidence: Real account suites sign in with valid passphrases; empty/incorrect password form behavior is NOT TESTED here.

controls.label: Sign in
controls.expected: Restores authenticated session or opens required MFA challenge.
controls.evidence: Real account suites complete sign-in; lifecycle also reaches the MFA challenge and completes it with a recovery code. Invalid sign-in state is not fully exercised by the UI inventory.

controls.label: Resend verification
controls.prerequisite: Sign-in form with an email address entered
controls.expected: Requests verification email with generic response copy to avoid account enumeration.
controls.evidence: Added to tests/accounts-ui.spec.js: submits a resend request from sign-in and asserts the generic response; The prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45; failure-specific behavior remains untested.

controls.label: Forgot password?
controls.expected: Opens reset request form.
controls.evidence: The guest flow opens reset mode, and lifecycle sends a real reset request and follows the emailed URL. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Email address
controls.expected: Requests a reset link without disclosing whether the account exists.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test submits a registered email and observes the generic reset result; unknown-address UI result is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Send reset link
controls.expected: Requests reset email through Better Auth.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test submits reset request, follows its email URL and completes the real Better Auth password reset. Nonexistent-address submission is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: New password
controls.expected: Requires at least 15 characters before resetting password.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test enters a valid new passphrase through the delivered reset link; short-password UI validation at the reset form is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Update password
controls.expected: Resets password and returns to sign-in.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test updates the password through the delivered reset token and signs in using the new password. Invalid/expired token UI is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Authenticator code or Recovery code
controls.expected: Accepts second-factor code without showing authenticated content early.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test enters a recovery code at the real MFA challenge. Authenticator-code challenge UI is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Use authenticator code / Use recovery code
controls.expected: Switches between authenticator and single-use recovery code entry.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test switches the sign-in challenge to recovery-code entry. Switching back to authenticator-code entry is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Verify and sign in
controls.prerequisite: Sign-in MFA challenge with valid code
controls.expected: Completes Better Auth's second-factor step and restores the session.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test completes the challenge with a real one-time recovery code; rejected or reused code UI is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Continue as guest
controls.expected: Returns to the guest workout overview.
controls.evidence: The guest flow continues from the Account note and verifies the workout Overview route in the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix (45/45). Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Overview
controls.expected: Shows metrics derived from the signed-in member's workspace.
controls.evidence: The profile workflow visits Overview, checks saved-goal metrics and follows its shortcuts; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Profile
controls.expected: Shows editable member details and training goal.
controls.evidence: The profile workflow edits, saves and cancels profile details; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Display name
controls.expected: Updates Better Auth profile name.
controls.evidence: A real save verifies consistency across workspace, export, and auth identity; failed save behavior remains untested.

controls.label: Weekly workout goal
controls.expected: Persists a 1–7 sessions per week goal to member workspace.
controls.evidence: The profile workflow test changes the weekly goal and verifies cloud persistence; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45 with name consistency assertions. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Save changes
controls.expected: Saves profile and goal with success/failure feedback.
controls.evidence: A real save verifies goal and name persistence; failed save feedback and retry behavior remain untested.

controls.label: Cancel changes
controls.prerequisite: Profile section with an unsaved name or goal change
controls.expected: Restores the latest saved profile and training goal without a backend write.
controls.evidence: The profile workflow changes name and goal, cancels, verifies saved values return, and confirms there was no workspace write; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: New email address
controls.expected: Validates new address before requesting secure verification.
controls.evidence: The lifecycle test follows current-inbox approval and new-inbox verification. The focused Firefox layout rerun passed at 320/390/1536 with a 56-character account email; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45; the built-assets matrix is pending.

controls.label: Send verification
controls.expected: Sends approval to the current inbox, then requires verification from the new inbox before the address changes.
controls.evidence: The lifecycle test follows current-inbox approval and new-inbox verification. The focused Firefox layout rerun passed at 320/390/1536 with a 56-character account email; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45; the built-assets matrix is pending. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Security
controls.expected: Shows password, MFA and sanitized sessions settings.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle and auth-controls workflows exercise Security settings and sessions; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Current password
controls.expected: Provides step-up proof for password change.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-auth-controls.spec.js reauthenticates with the current password before changing it; The prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45; failure-specific behavior remains untested.

controls.label: New password
controls.expected: Requires at least 15 characters.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-auth-controls.spec.js submits the new password and checks it can authenticate; The prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45; failure-specific behavior remains untested.

controls.label: Confirm new password
controls.expected: Requires a match before submission.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-auth-controls.spec.js supplies matching password confirmation; The prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45; failure-specific behavior remains untested.

controls.label: Update password
controls.prerequisite: Valid current and matching new password
controls.expected: Updates password and revokes other sessions.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-auth-controls.spec.js verifies password update and revocation of another session; The prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45; failure-specific behavior remains untested.

controls.label: Confirm your password
controls.expected: Requires recent authentication before TOTP enrollment.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test supplies a valid password to begin real TOTP enrollment. Incorrect-password handling is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Set up authenticator
controls.expected: Starts TOTP setup and displays the secret only for enrollment.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test begins real TOTP enrollment and reads its setup key. Enrollment failure handling is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Authenticator code
controls.expected: Accepts six digit TOTP code.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test calculates and enters a valid six-digit TOTP code to enable MFA. Invalid code handling is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Verify and enable
controls.expected: Confirms enrollment and exposes backup codes once.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test verifies TOTP and enables MFA; invalid/replayed-code UI is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Generate new recovery codes
controls.prerequisite: MFA enabled and recent password confirmation
controls.expected: Requires password, explicitly warns it replaces all existing codes, and generates a new one-time set.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-auth-controls.spec.js tests password-gated rotation and confirms codes change; The prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45; failure-specific behavior remains untested.

controls.label: Download codes
controls.expected: Downloads codes as a local text file.
controls.evidence: The lifecycle workflow downloads the recovery-code file and verifies the file contains a valid issued code; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Turn off
controls.expected: Opens masked password confirmation and disables TOTP only after successful reauthentication.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-auth-controls.spec.js tests password-gated disable after the cancel path; The prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45; failure-specific behavior remains untested.

controls.label: Refresh sessions
controls.expected: Reloads sanitized session list without exposing tokens or internal IDs.
controls.evidence: Refresh lists both real active sessions; loading, error, and empty-state behavior remain untested.

controls.label: Revoke
controls.expected: Revokes only the selected session.
controls.evidence: Successful revocation removes the second browser session; recent-auth rejection and request-failure behavior remain untested.

controls.label: Sign out other devices
controls.prerequisite: At least one other active session and confirmation
controls.expected: Revokes every other session after service authorization.
controls.evidence: Confirmed revoke-others invalidates the second session; recent-auth rejection and request-failure behavior remain untested.

controls.label: Sign out everywhere
controls.expected: Revokes all sessions and clears the local authenticated view.
controls.evidence: Confirmed global sign-out ends both sessions and blocks private workspace access; recent-auth rejection and request-failure behavior remain untested.

controls.label: Training data
controls.expected: Shows account-scoped routines, workout history and sync state.
controls.evidence: The migration workflow reviews local data, exports a cloud copy, imports and checks persisted state; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Export my data
controls.expected: Downloads a JSON export from the account service.
controls.evidence: The workflow downloads the existing cloud copy and checks its filename; export failure handling remains untested.

controls.label: Import workout backup
controls.expected: Validates backup and opens review without writing immediately.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-workouts.spec.js uploads a valid JSON backup, confirms cancel leaves cloud unchanged, then imports after review, acknowledgement and cloud export; The prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45; failure-specific behavior remains untested.

controls.label: Review local data
controls.expected: Shows counts and asks for explicit confirmation before cloud replacement.
controls.evidence: The migration workflow reviews source counts and confirms the browser copy remains available; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: I reviewed the counts and saved a copy of my current cloud training data.
controls.expected: Explicitly acknowledges the replacement after the current cloud export is downloaded.
controls.evidence: The migration workflow confirms replacement remains disabled before required acknowledgement and cloud backup; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Import to account
controls.expected: Imports only after explicit confirmation and current-cloud export; reports errors without data loss claims.
controls.evidence: A valid backup imports after review, acknowledgement, and cloud export while localStorage remains intact; import failure handling remains untested.

controls.label: Download current cloud copy before replacing / Cloud copy downloaded
controls.expected: Downloads the existing cloud data and enables replacement only after export succeeds.
controls.evidence: Import remains gated until a real cloud backup download completes; export failure behavior remains untested.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.expected: Closes review without replacing cloud data.
controls.evidence: The workflow cancels local and file-import reviews and confirms cloud state remains unchanged; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Reload cloud data
controls.expected: Reloads only after explicit acknowledgement that the unsynced edits will be replaced by cloud state.
controls.evidence: The real-backend test exports attempted edits, acknowledges data replacement, and reloads cloud state; reload failure/retry behavior remains untested.

controls.label: Export my unsynced changes
controls.prerequisite: Unresolved sync conflict with attempted payload available
controls.expected: Downloads the attempted member data as JSON before reload.
controls.evidence: The conflict test downloads attempted unsynced data before resolution; export failure behavior remains untested.

controls.label: I understand reloading replaces my unsynced edits.
controls.expected: Requires explicit acknowledgement before reload is enabled.
controls.evidence: The conflict test verifies reload remains unavailable before the explicit acknowledgement; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Open routines
controls.expected: Navigates to the member's routines in the workout workspace.
controls.evidence: The profile workflow follows Open routines to the workout workspace and verifies its My routines view; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Open history
controls.expected: Navigates to the member's workout history.
controls.evidence: The profile workflow follows Open history to the workout workspace and verifies its history view; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Privacy

controls.evidence: Lifecycle and security workflows visit Privacy for sign-out and deletion actions; the prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Sign out
controls.expected: Ends current session and clears private workspace view.
controls.evidence: The security test signs out one tab and verifies the shared account session no longer exposes the previous member data. Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Review account deletion

controls.evidence: Lifecycle test opens deletion review and completes the password/DELETE/email-confirmation flow.

controls.label: Confirm your password
controls.expected: Requires password confirmation.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test submits the account password when requesting deletion; incorrect-password failure is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Type DELETE to confirm

controls.evidence: Lifecycle test enters exact DELETE before the request; other phrase behavior is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Cancel

Keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly verified for this control, so §15 coverage remains partial.

controls.label: Send confirmation email

controls.expected: Requests Better Auth deletion email; states that account remains active until the confirmation link is used.
controls.evidence: Lifecycle test confirms the request sends email while account remains active, then follows confirmation link and verifies session removal. Invalid/replayed link UI is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: This week / Weekly rhythm

controls.evidence: tests/accounts-auth-controls.spec.js confirms the password through a masked field before disabling MFA; The prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed 45/45; failure-specific behavior remains untested.

testRuns.environment: Playwright isolated Fastify/Vite/PostgreSQL harness; Chromium desktop/mobile, Firefox, WebKit desktop/mobile
testRuns.evidence: The frozen-source development matrix passed 45/45 at c5bd2a1: all five browser projects passed 9/9. It covered the long-email Profile layout assertion at 320/390/1536, real file import/CAS, recovery-code download content, and guest/session flows. This is a completed development-only run on the earlier account source.

testRuns.evidence: QA confirmed the full built-assets matrix passed 45/45 at b426960, with all five browser projects passing 9/9. This result is separate from the development project run.

testRuns.environment: Playwright isolated Fastify/Vite/PostgreSQL harness; Chromium desktop/mobile, Firefox, WebKit desktop/mobile
testRuns.evidence: The development run at b426960 was interrupted before completion and has no final case result. It is not counted as a pass or failure.

testRuns.environment: Playwright isolated Fastify/Vite/PostgreSQL harness; development and built assets, Chromium desktop/mobile, Firefox, WebKit desktop/mobile
testRuns.evidence: Exact candidate ebbec2e passed 45/45 development and 45/45 production-built cases, nine per project in each run. The independent reviewer inspected both complete final logs.

testRuns.environment: Playwright isolated account harness, Chromium desktop
testRuns.evidence: Historical partial run before the bounded test-only Better Auth rate-limit fix: some browser bootstrap requests returned 429. Later development runs passed; this historical result is superseded.

testRuns.environment: Playwright isolated account harness, Chromium mobile
testRuns.evidence: Historical failure before the viewport-aware mobile navigation helper fix: six cases failed because off-canvas nav items were treated as visible. The helper was corrected; a later prior c5bd2a1 development matrix passed Chromium mobile and WebKit mobile 9/9 each. This historical result is superseded.

visualReview.note: The integrator inspected guest/Overview/Profile evidence plus final-source Chromium Security, Training data and Privacy captures at 390px and1536px. These six states fit without horizontal overflow; navigation, forms, migration card, session controls and destructive-action explanation remain readable. Earlier Firefox Profile captures at320/390/1536 also fit. Captures use synthetic local members. Expanded, loading, error and all keyboard states remain incomplete, so visual/control acceptance stays PARTIAL. Exact ebbec2e browser matrices passed45 development+45 built cases.

remainingGaps: Per-control keyboard focus and activation are not explicitly exercised. Desktop/mobile Playwright success paths do not establish the required keyboard interaction, so no control is labeled PASS until that evidence exists.

Authentication validation/error paths not covered end to end: duplicate or invalid registration, incorrect sign-in credentials, unknown reset address, expired reset token, invalid/replayed MFA code, and password-policy rejection during reset.

Security rejection paths remain untested: wrong current password for password/MFA/recovery-code changes, invalid MFA/recovery codes, stale-auth rejection for session revocation, and session-refresh loading/error states.
Data failure paths remain untested: malformed or over-limit backup file, failed cloud export before replacement, failed import, and conflict reload/export failure or retry.
Deletion rejection paths remain untested: wrong password, incorrect confirmation phrase, and invalid/replayed deletion link.
Default Security/Training data/Privacy desktop/mobile captures are reviewed; expanded/error/loading visual states and exhaustive per-control keyboard acceptance remain outstanding.
